Here is what was wrong and what we changed.

### Cause of the “raw path” sidebar (`algorithm.details.design.name`, etc.)

`TreeItem` resolved labels with `label ?? localizedLabel`. For `label={null}`, `??` still uses `localizedLabel`, so `useLabel(id)` ran and i18next returned the **key string** for unknown keys. That duplicated the long ids next to your real key/value content.

### Fixes

1. **`elements/ui` – `TreeItem`**  
   Use `label !== undefined ? label : localizedLabel` so an explicit `null` means “no tree label” (content-only row).

2. **`TreeRow`**  
   Accept an optional `label` and pass it through to `TreeItem` (documented, including using `null` for content-only rows).

3. **`compose/ui` – `AlgorithmDetailsPanel`**  
   Set `label={null}` on every `TreeRow` that only renders your own two-column content, so only **Design / Vec / Selection / Output** section headers show as titles, not internal ids.

4. **IPO-style canvas layout**  
   Added **`createIpoAlgorithmLayout`**: one **stack** column for all **input** window kinds (`VEC_INPUT` + `PIECES_SELECTION_INPUT` as tabs), plus columns for **diff** and **output**—aligned with the three-pane IPO idea and closer to the `elements/UI` shell than four equal strips.  
   **`createAlgorithmLayout`** now uses this when `defaultLayout` is omitted.

5. **`compose/algorithms/index.ts`**  
   Re-export **`createIpoAlgorithmLayout`** for stories or tools that need the same layout object.
